import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create sample DataFrame
df_pandas = pd.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "David"],
    "spend": [500, 1200, 1000, 800]
})

# Convert to narwhals and add tier column
df = nw.from_native(df_pandas)
df = df.with_columns(
    tier=nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000).then(nw.lit("gold")).otherwise(nw.lit("standard"))
)

# Display result
print(nw.to_native(df))
